text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've always admired it...
How Teio-san looked on that day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I won—!! Well, that was a given, wasn't it♪"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely win the next Kikuka Sho too! To make my dream come true—to become an Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone there was dreaming of what comes next.
Captivated, ecstatic, believing for sure
that they would witness something even more incredible—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No one could take their eyes off her.
It made me realize what a true star really is.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (This is bad... I'm completely spacing out...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It's still echoing in my ears...
That roar of the Derby crowd... hitting me like a wall of sound...)
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I need to... concentrate...
But...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Is it really okay for me to stay like this...?
I don't have the kind of resolve Duramente has.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Whether it's Crown-san's spirit to take on challenges, or Kita-san's positive attitude—)
—Aaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Waaaauuuggghhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Kita-san?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...So cool...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Always giving it her all.
Even after experiencing such a massive race...
she keeps running without fear—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Truly, someone like me is totally...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, crying...gah!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(W-W-W-What should I do...?!
I ended up asking 'What's wrong?' without thinking, but...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She probably doesn't want to talk to someone like me...
But leaving her like that is just...!)
(—*snort!*)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha, sorry!
I made a total fool of myself, didn't I!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...!
Not at all, that's not—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're so kind...
Even though it's the truth...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Running while crying...
Man, I'm seriously so uncool—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-You look... totally cool, Kita-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"W-Well, it might not mean much coming from me, but...
S-She's always... staying positive and looking forward..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me, positive...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Positive, huh?! ...Aha.
Thanks, Cheval-chan.
For putting it like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the truth is... it's not like that.
I'm... not positive at all."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look, even right now,
I'm so conscious of it that my head's a complete mess...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I keep thinking about what happened that day……
over and over again……

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Even running to forget,
I couldn't shake it off at all... ngh."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... "Want to forget"... What does that—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
............
――Duramente-san... in the Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At first, you know,
all I thought was, "Huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Strong... an Umamusume from a famous family... Everyone expects so much... watching closely..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I thought I had what it takes too.
Becoming a star Umamusume through the Triple Crown races
has always been my dream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If you give it your all, it'll be fine!
You can easily shatter any low expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, once she actually ran—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just the footsteps alone made my whole body tingle.
It felt like that overwhelming, ferocious burst of speed
was charging right up behind me—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And... that wild frenzy in the stands...—
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking at Duramente...
Captivated and full of anticipation
for her next run—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She looked just like her... My idol, Tokai Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't become one.
The real star was Duramente-san."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Kita-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still...
What really makes me feel pathetic happened after that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan...
I just realized something...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "If only we were in different generations—" he said.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If only Duramente-san wasn't around,
maybe an ordinary girl like me could have shone a little—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm just weak, yet I keep blaming others. It's so petty... and pathetic—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm like this,
I could never become a star!
Because I was pathetic, and weak!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah...
I know this feeling, too...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Compared to me, Big Sis and Vivlos are so extraordinary, glamorous, and always in the spotlight...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (If... those two hadn't been there...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't help but wonder...
what if I'd been born an only child?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(If they weren't here,
I could've stayed unaware of how inferior I am...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (To think that way about my precious family... I'm so pathetic, so disgraceful...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(“I understand”... If I said something like that,
would it just upset them?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Still... watching Kita-san hurting like this is just...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah...... U-U-Um, K-Kita-san...! I, uh, wanted to—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! It's an emergency, look at Umatter!!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
They say Duramente-san suffered a fracture!
'Discovered after the Derby, facing a lengthy layoff'!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way!?
Even after being so amazing in the Derby!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... A race without
Duramente-san... No way!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Injured...? Duramente did...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm with her... with Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san too, after the Derby...
She wasn't able to run in the autumn races...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Why...? How can you
be so alike, even in that way...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's the matter, Kita-san—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Kita-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Not here either...
Where did Kita-san go...?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: To think she was struggling that much...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I thought Kita-san was the type
who never got down in the dumps like me...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's always so positive...
I thought she'd never harbor any dark feelings...
And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: We're the same... Even Kita-san...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Comparing myself to others, worrying, feeling down...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: It wasn't just me—
